Given that the triangle $△ABC$ shown above is isosceles, the measure of $\overset{―}{AC}$ must be equal to{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Since $△ABC$ is an isosceles triangle with base $\overset{―}{AB}$, we have that $\overset{―}{AC}≅\overset{―}{CB}.$ Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}AC & =CB \\ 3x-9 & =2x-1 \\ x & =8.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this value into the expression for the measure of $\overset{―}{AC}$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}AC & =3x-9 \\  & =3(8)-9 \\  & =15.\end{aligned}
$$
